$comment: Refactor discussions (protocol.md §30, 'Specs outlive implementations'). A file over limits.refactorReviewLines is due for discussion; once discussed it is acknowledged here at its size, and is due again only after growing limits.refactorReviewGrowthPct past it. Read by sdk-health (scripts/lib/complexity.js).

scripts/pre-tag.js.prerequisite: Write its capabilities into context/spec/sdk-core (pre-tag review: coherence, cohesion, validate, health, --fix) with covering tests before any rewrite.
scripts/pre-tag.js.by: Greg (CEO), baseline at adoption of the refactor watch

scripts/init.js.prerequisite: Write its capabilities into context/spec/sdk-core (scaffold, squad/type maps, harness copy, .sdkrc + limits, settings + hooks) with covering tests before any rewrite.
scripts/init.js.by: Greg (CEO), baseline at adoption of the refactor watch

scripts/commands/inbox.js.prerequisite: Capabilities cap-inbox-* are built and pinned (scripts/lib/test-cap-inbox.js), so the split is safe: separate card sources (bus, surfaces, charter, overdue, holding) from rendering and the answer path.

scripts/ops.js.prerequisite: Pinned by cap-sess-ops-* (test-cap-session.js). Split per check family when next touched; the 4 text-date checks (cap-sess-ops-006) are the first candidates.

scripts/health.js.prerequisite: Pinned by cap-sess-health-* (test-cap-session.js). Move each numbered check into scripts/lib/health-checks/<name>.js when the next check is added; no new inline checks.
